title: Can AI Agents Help Robotic Engineers? Lessons from Two Focus Days in Industry
abstract: arXiv:2610.32636v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Software developers increasingly use AI agents that execute multi-step programming tasks on their own. However, it is unclear if and how this transfers to robotic engineering, where engineers program industrial robots in niche, vendor-specific languages and rely on visual feedback from simulation tools. Within this paper, we report a case study on the use of AI agents by an SME that programs industrial robots. Our results show that the agent did not make the engineers more productive, with the exception of a task that required the generation of highly repetitive code. However, the results with the agent improved over time, as the engineers learned how to use it and the agent was adapted to the domain. Moreover, the experience with AI mattered more for the success with the agent than the experience with robotic engineering. This shows that AI agents are not a plug-and-play solution. translated_title: AI智能体能帮助机器人工程师吗？来自工业界两个专注日的经验教训
translated_abstract: 软件开发人员越来越多地使用能够自主执行多步骤编程任务的AI智能体。然而，尚不清楚这种情况是否以及如何适用于机器人工程领域，在该领域中，工程师使用小众的、供应商专有的语言对工业机器人进行编程，并依赖仿真工具的视觉反馈。本文报告了一项关于一家工业机器人编程中小企业使用AI智能体的案例研究。我们的结果表明，除了一项需要生成高度重复代码的任务之外，AI智能体并未提高工程师的工作效率。然而，随着工程师逐渐学会如何使用该智能体，以及该智能体被适配到该领域，使用智能体的效果随时间推移而改善。此外，AI使用经验对成功使用智能体的影响比机器人工程经验更大。这表明AI智能体并非即插即用的解决方案，企业必须对其工程师进行培训（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究通过对一家工业机器人编程中小企业的案例研究，发现AI智能体并非即插即用的解决方案——除了生成高度重复代码的任务外未能提升工程师效率，其使用效果随工程师的AI使用经验和智能体的领域适配而逐步改善，且AI使用经验比机器人工程经验对成功更为关键。
en_tdlr: A case study of an SME programming industrial robots reveals that AI agents are not plug-and-play: they only improved productivity for highly repetitive code generation, their effectiveness grew over time as engineers learned to use them and they were domain-adapted, and prior AI experience mattered more than robotics engineering expertise.
